question.worked_solution:
We're given that $Z∼N(0,1),$ and we wish to compute $P(0.28<Z<1.82).$ The required probability is represented by the area shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14254773/assets/e50d6c8822357b7b8f21684e36133c91c2c6d541ab7f66951035eef5e9a239e6.png)

By the definition of the cumulative distribution function $Φ(z),$ 

$$
P(Z\le z)=Φ(z).
$$

So, we express the required probability in terms of $Φ(z)$:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(0.28<Z<1.82) & =P(Z<1.82)-P(Z\le 0.28) \\  & =P(Z\le 1.82)-P(Z\le 0.28) \\  & =Φ(1.82)-Φ(0.28)\end{aligned}
$$

From the tables, we have the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}Φ(0.28) & =0.6103 \\ Φ(1.82) & =0.9656\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(0.28<Z<1.82) & =Φ(1.82)-Φ(0.28) \\  & =0.9656-0.6103 \\  & =0.3553.\end{aligned}
$$
